subject.title: feat(ui): gateway browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect in the web Control UI

question: After the correctness fixes, should the first web Control UI browser release include navigation, pointer and keyboard forwarding, page evaluation, annotation, and inspect together?
rationale: The linked issue and PR carry protected maintainer, product, and security-review signals, and this is a broad new operator-admin product surface rather than a routine repair.

options.title: Stage a narrower release
options.body: Land the strongest proven read, capture, and annotation workflow first, then add broader interactions after focused calibration.

options.title: Ship the full panel
options.body: Retain all interaction modes after repairing every finding and proving the combined workflow.

options.title: Defer the core surface
options.body: Keep browser operation in existing agent and tool paths if this is not an intended permanent Control UI capability.

recommendation.title: Stage a narrower release
recommendation.body: Land the strongest proven read, capture, and annotation workflow first, then add broader interactions after focused calibration.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties this person most directly to the terminal dock, chat workspace, and bundled browser ownership patterns involved in the product choice.
